light.notes: bg mantle, paper base, chip crust, border surface0 and surface1, text subtext0 and overlay1, primary mauve, amber is peach. Latte's text ink is a mid grey, so no ink reaches 4.5 on green, peach, or yellow. A fill dark enough for white ink would be a different colour from the published one, so the three stay as published: white reads 3.3 on green and 3.0 on peach, and the text ink 3.1 on yellow (MAD-378)
